First find the mean of the data: $\frac{1+12-17-3-11-5}{6}=-\frac{23}{6}$.

Then subtract the mean from each data point and square the result.\begin{align*}
(1+\frac{23}{6})^2 &=\frac{3584}{36}, \\
(12+\frac{23}{6})^2 &=\frac{5184}{36}, \\
(-17+\frac{23}{6})^2 &=\frac{2809}{36}, \\
(-3+\frac{23}{6})^2 &=\frac{2304}{36}, \\
(-11+\frac{23}{6})^2 &=\frac{1444}{36}, \\
(-5+\frac{23}{6})^2 &=\frac{5625}{144}.
\end{align*}The mean of these is $\frac{1}{6} \left(\frac{3584}{36}+\frac{5184}{36}+\frac{2809}{36}+\frac{2304}{36}+\frac{1444}{36}+ \frac{5625}{144}\right)=118$. The standard deviation is the square root of that value, namely $\boxed{\sqrt{118}}$.
